acceptance.given: The implementation binding section and A1-A4 labels are present as authoring guidance in the frozen requirements input.

oracle.expected: The inspected compiled plan or contract artifact represents binding metadata as non-normative authoring metadata and contains no product-scope entry or published slice/evidence identity derived from A1-A4 labels.
forbidden: Binding metadata is treated as new product scope.
A1-A4 labels are used as published slice IDs or evidence identities.
oracle.observable: A contract-validation assertion inspects the artifact's scope and identity fields during compilation validation.

acceptance.then: Compilation preserves binding metadata as authoring-only information and emits no product scope or published identity from A1-A4 labels.
acceptance.when: During compiler contract validation, inspect the generated plan or contract artifact for scope and published identity fields.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The focused compiler contract assertion fails when binding metadata creates a product-scope entry or publishes an A1-A4 label as a slice or evidence identity.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate that implementation binding guidance remains non-normative metadata and cannot introduce product scope or published identities.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No production file or schema is changed; rollback removes only the added contract assertion.

slice_hint.state_transition: Binding metadata remains authoring guidance, with no scope or identity records emitted from A1-A4 labels.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The focused compiler contract validation passes only when the artifact contains no product-scope or published slice/evidence identity derived from binding metadata or A1-A4 labels.
